definitions.gloss: water outage, water cutoff, suspension of water supply
definitions.explanation: The temporary interruption of water supply, whether planned or due to an emergency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{断水|だんすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The water will be cut off due to construction work.

examples.japanese: {断水|だんすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}めた→貯める：27801_tameru⟧。
examples.english: I stored water in preparation for the water outage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{断水|だんすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The water outage is continuing due to the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {断水|だんすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}めておいた→貯める：27801_tameru⟧。
examples.english: A notice about the water shutoff arrived, so I filled the bathtub with water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三日間|みっかかん}→三日：02969_mikka⟧{断水|だんすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}→給水車：27490_kyuusuisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: The water outage lasted three days due to the typhoon, and we were saved when the water truck came.

notes:
{断水|だんすい} refers to the interruption of water supply, whether planned (for maintenance) or unplanned (due to disaster).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {断水|だんすい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: water is cut off
- {断水|だんすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cut off water
- {断水|だんすい}⟦{復旧|ふっきゅう}→復旧：07521_fukkyuu⟧: restoration of water supply
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧{断水|だんすい}: planned water shutoff
- {断水|だんすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧: water shutoff notice

RELATED UTILITY TERMS:
- ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧: power outage
- ⟦{給水|きゅうすい}→給水：15031_kyuusui⟧: water supply
- ⟦{給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}→給水車：27490_kyuusuisha⟧: water supply truck

USAGE:
During {断水|だんすい}, people commonly fill bathtubs and containers in advance. In Japan, utility shutoff notices are distributed to residents beforehand for planned outages.
